title: Ikrar Rahim .
intro: Lam kama-kama nyang hana su lam saboh hate nyang geukhususkan keu Ilahi, saboh nazar suci geukonsep. Nazar nyoe meupusat bak udep nyang gohlom nafsu, dan peunoh jih akan meuubah jalan warisan rohani keu siumu masa. Langkah u dalam misteri jiwa nyang janji jih meugema troh keukai.
clues: Lon tinggai lam rumoh tangga nyang jituri deungon taqwa, dan lon meuheut keu saboh hadiah nyang jeuet keu peutoe lon ngon Allah.
Lon peugot janji nyang suci ngon Tuhan lon keuhai peue nyang teusöm lam droe lon, lon meujanji keu lon peuseumah mandum nyan keu layanan Gobnyan.
Watèë ka trôh watèë peuhah, peuë njang ulôn teurimong njan hana ulôn sangka, tapi ulôn peucaya peukara njan bak Nyang Maha-Maha Teupeuë.
Lon bri nan keu aneuk lon nyang tanda bakti, dan lon lakee peulindong keu jih dan keuturonan jih nibak nyang teukutok.
Aneuëk lôn geupeuduek lam Ruweueng Suci, dimiyueb geujaga lé sidroe nabi nibak keuturonan Nabi Harun.
Putroe ulôn ka jituri ngon keusucian jih dan jipiléh leubeh nibak mandum inong, dudoe jeuet keu mak sidroe nabi nyang rayeuk, bah pih teutap hana jisentuh.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
